main_text.p: da est regula: Loci communes parentur in ea disciplina, in qua cupimus excellere: & ita parentur, vt sequamur ductum alicuius systematis methodici: denique non semel & simul impleantur, sed per interualla, adnotatis solùm 5iis, quæ sunt rariora.

p.i: 1. De fine peregrinationis diu multumq; cogitato, & prudentium quoque amicorum consilio hac in parte utere.
3. Tum demum ad peregrinandum appelle animum, quando iecisti fundamenta solida doctrina; & tam diu emaneto, donec fructum & scopum peregrinationis tuæ sis assecutus[?].
4. In diario notato quæ inter peregrinandum occurrunt insi-gniora.
6. Accurate dispice, quanam tibi adeunda sint loca: & partim ex doctis viris atq; amicis, partim ex libris geographicis cognosce, quid in hoc vel illo loco sit imprimis obseruandum.
7. Illorum amicitiam & beneuolentiam tibi concilia, qui à ra-

main_text.p: 8. Peregrinatio literata, sit vel grammatica, sive philologica, h.e. linguarum exoticarum causâ suscipiatur: vel topica, h.e. cognoscendorum locorum causâ instituatur: vel ethi-ca, i.e. morum causâ perficiatur: vel pragmatica, h.e. suscipiatur rerum ipsarum causâ, quæ in singulis locis raræ vi-su auditue reperiuntur. Peregrinatio valetudinaria, militaris, & religiosa non conuenit literarum studiolo, quâ tali.

p.i: Et hactenus quidem vidimus ea, quæ quatuor facultatibus sunt
communia: deinceps singulas perfequemur, quatenus quidem in Iacris[?] literis ipsarum vestigia occurrunt.

main_text.head: PHILOSOPHIA IN GENERE
main_text.p: 35I. PHilosophia est vera, vel falsa. Hæc distinctio fundata est Rom. 1. v. 19. 20. 21. & c. 2. v. 14. 15.

page.notes: Printed line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 stand in the left margin and are given as notes. The printed figures at 25 and 30 sit beside lines whose text is partly obscured. Doubtful readings: "assecutus" (ink is faint), "rà" at the line break of item 7, "Iacris" (the initial may be a damaged S), and "vtere". The word "conuenit" has an odd glyph in the print and was read as conuenit. "Inperegrinando" is printed without a space. "da eft" and "fit" were corrected to est and sit per the long-s rule. The initial P of "Philosophia" is a woodcut letter. The heading "VI." is a bare number and is set as a paragraph.
